title: IOB Local Bank Officer LBO Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: 250 Local Bank Officer posts in Junior Management Grade Scale-I under IOB LBO recruitment 2026-27
qualification: Graduation from a recognized university; local language proficiency as per IOB LBO notification; other conditions as advertised
ageLimit: As per IOB LBO 2026-27 notification (category-wise relaxations applicable)
applicationFee: As per IOB online fee / intimation charges (category-wise)
selectionProcess: Online Examination → Language Proficiency Test (LPT) → Interview → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, educational certificates, category certificate, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.iob.bank.in Careers
2. Open Recruitment of Local Bank Officers 2026-27
3. Register online and note registration number
4. Fill form, upload documents, pay fee
5. Submit between 08–24 August 2026 and print application
shortDescription: IOB Local Bank Officer LBO Online Form 2026 for 250 posts (JMGS-I). Apply 08–24 Aug 2026 at iob.bank.in.
content:
Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has released the notification for recruitment of Local Bank Officers (LBO) in JMGS-I.

Total vacancies: 250. Online applications are open from 08 August 2026 to 24 August 2026.

Selection

  • Online exam
  • Language Proficiency Test (as applicable)
  • Interview
  • Probation typically 2 years as per notification

Apply only through the official IOB careers page / IBPS registration link mentioned in the advertisement.
